Try the current feed

const response = await fetch('/api/top-skills.json');
if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
const snapshot = await response.json();
console.log(snapshot.generatedAt, snapshot.items);

These endpoints serve published static snapshots, not a live stream or authenticated API backend. This owner-private preview requires hosting access; external applications should not assume anonymous access or CORS availability. The example runs from this site's origin.

Response and freshness

The discovery feed includes schemaVersion, generatedAt, scope and items. Each entry includes repository, stars, starsCheckedAt, fetchStatus, licence and limitations. Missing or stale upstream data stays labelled. Capability evidence separates source review from the one bounded task test.

A possible paid product

Free repository discovery could lead to paid maintained enrichment: agent compatibility, reviewed install recipes, source and evidence history, and task recommendations. This model is proposed, with demand, pricing and economics unvalidated.

API keys, metering, historical and recommendation endpoints are planned. They do not exist yet. No checkout, subscription or key generation is active.
